concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-001 references '(See US-1)', but no User Story with ID 'US-1' is defined anywhere in the document. The same undefined reference appears in FR-002, FR-003 (US-1), FR-004, FR-005 (US-2), and FR-006‑FR-009 (US-3). This breaks traceability and creates ambiguous linkage between requirements and user stories.

The Constitution appears twice (once under 'Constitution' and again under 'Constitution (FR-030)') with identical content. Duplicate sections are unnecessary and may cause confusion about which version is authoritative.
